_comment: Claude-authored operator-gateway recordings — the canned demo engine (SELOM_AI_GATEWAY=operator). `explanations` are grounded facts keyed by request_type:key — explain_score by scorecard.paper_id (reproducibility/tier/confidence/findings), grade_advice by skill_id:mode (the figure's statistical test + assumptions, from ai.grade), draft_methods by skill_id (a polished version of that skill's deterministic methods prose, preserving every number/test/citation). `plans` are goal-keyed ActionPlans replayed by propose() — the ingest design refiner's zero-credit demo (a scripted goal; the mapper never applies a proposed level absent from the detected design, so an illustrative payload is safe). No fabricated values, ≤120 words, mirrors the live gateway. Spec: docs/ai-gateway-wiring/spec.md + docs/ai-cross-stage-entry-points/build-spec.md + docs/methods-draft/spec.md. propose_sweep is intentionally left to the deterministic ranker (rank_sweep_space).

explanations.text: Reproducibility 63/100 places this paper in the 'deposit-faithful' tier: Selom reproduced what the deposited data supports, but the headline is held down because 2 panels are paper-irreproducible — the published figure can't be recovered from the data the authors deposited, which is a limit of the deposit, not a Selom error (Selom confidence stays high at 92/100). 9 panel comparisons reproduced. 7 of 10 in-scope panels scored; 3 are form-only, where the figure type is matched but exact values aren't gradable. To raise the score, supply the underlying data for the form-only panels — the irreproducible ones reflect the paper's deposit, not the pipeline.

Reproducibility 86/100 — the 'reproduced' tier — at full Selom confidence (100/100). All 7 in-scope panels scored and 14 panel comparisons reproduced with zero paper-irreproducible findings, so nothing here is blamed on the deposit or the pipeline. The score sits below 100 because several panels reproduced closely rather than exactly. 4 panels are out-of-scope — schematics and non-data figures Selom doesn't grade. This is a strong, trustworthy reproduction; to push toward 'verified', tighten the close-but-not-exact panels by matching the paper's exact thresholds and normalization.

Reproducibility 96/100 earns the top 'verified' tier at full Selom confidence (100/100). All 5 in-scope panels scored, 9 panel comparisons reproduced, and there are no paper-irreproducible or discrepant findings — Selom recovered the published figures from the data essentially exactly. 1 panel is out-of-scope, a non-gradable figure type. This is the cleanest of the showcase reproductions: the small gap from 100 reflects minor numeric rounding rather than any structural disagreement. No action is needed to trust these panels — they are a faithful, end-to-end reproduction of the paper's results.

This DEG figure uses pyDESeq2 — a negative-binomial GLM with a Wald test on the condition coefficient — and reports Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values (padj). It assumes you fed it raw integer counts (not normalized or logged), with at least two independent biological replicates per group; three or more is safer. Trust the padj column, not the raw p, when picking significant genes. If your replicates span batches, add the batch as a covariate so the contrast isn't confounded; with a large or complex design, limma-voom fits faster with similar results.

Differential expression was quantified with PyDESeq2, a Python reimplementation of DESeq2: raw counts were modelled with a negative-binomial generalized linear model and the condition coefficient tested with the Wald test, while single-cell inputs were ranked per group with the Wilcoxon rank-sum test (Scanpy). P-values were corrected for multiple testing by the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure, and the top-ranked genes are reported for the specified contrast. Analysis was performed using Selom.

Volcano plot of differential expression, plotting -log10 adjusted p-value against log2 fold change. Genes passing the fold-change and false-discovery-rate thresholds are highlighted, with the most significant genes labelled; up- and down-regulated genes are coloured separately.
